where_you_are_statement_refs: The combined SOI contains 392 contacts, about half attributed to the operator, with roughly 50 personal relationships believed top-of-mind. The database is an incomplete spreadsheet without email completion or segmentation and receives outside update support. Postcards recur every five to six weeks while personal outreach is random and acknowledged as under-systematized.

The operator reports insufficient current opportunity generation. SOI contact and local networking are available lanes; other named lanes are intentions rather than evidenced engines. Current evidence cannot separate generation scarcity from capture, qualification, follow-up, or market effects.
The governed evidence makes follow-up / conversion material, but the accepted state does not establish a separate conclusion for it.

Listing, buyer, lead, transaction, and recruiting steps are articulated. The operator retains primary transaction follow-through while using coordinator support as needed. Operational repeatability is unverified despite the operator describing current processes as working.

Coaching is present for business development and recruiting. Routine business execution is primarily self-accountable or unowned. The operator attributes limitation to organization, time management, and distraction.

Units, sales volume, gross, and expenses are reported for incompletely defined periods. Reported units and volume imply an average sale price below the separately stated average. Agent net, owner compensation, owner profit, cash, reserves, and contribution by source or closing are not established.

Profit and business contribution are reported as equal while the operator reports performing most team work. The business partner participates in joint lead and client follow-up. No person-level team synthesis is authorized for the reported partner relationship.

The operator has explicit production, delegation, team, and office goals across multiple horizons. The reported current team pace is below the near-term monthly closing target. The growth plan lacks evidenced demand, economics, role, and process gates.

destinations.name: WHAT’S DRIVING IT
destinations.mission: Understand the supported causal mechanisms, alternatives and conditions that would change the view.

statements.text: Leader-centered execution without a governed relationship, delegation, measurement, and accountability system.
Relationship value is weakly captured because contact completeness, state, recency, segmentation, and next actions are not governed.
Work, decisions, relationship continuity, and accountability converge on one operator instead of transferable roles and systems.
Sparse instrumentation prevents diagnosis of whether demand, conversion, capacity, or market effects govern output.
Seat scope, task value, decision rights, and economic sharing are not sufficiently measured to establish alignment.
Additional people may multiply coordination requirements before the operating model is ready to convert them into productive capacity.
Incomplete financial lineage prevents production from being translated into decision-ready economic capacity.

destinations.name: WHAT CHANGES IT
destinations.mission: See the selected bounded intervention and the mechanism it is designed to test.

statements.text: End-to-end ownership transfer trial. Transfer one recurring workflow with explicit decision rights, quality boundaries, exception rules, and inspected completion.
Requested organization, delegation, and team growth make transferability the immediate capacity question.

Evidence that would support the move: Workflow continuity persists across repeated cycles without hidden operator rescue. Released operator capacity is demonstrably redirected to relationship, system, or accountability work. Role and decision records support a clearer leverage-readiness judgment.

Evidence that would challenge the move: Nominal delegation leaves decisions and follow-through with the operator. Rescue work or quality failures expand. Operator capacity is neither released nor redirected.

destinations.name: HOW YOU EXECUTE IT
destinations.mission: Translate the move into prerequisites, ownership, steps, proof and execution adjustments.

statements.text: Select one recurring workflow that currently returns to the operator.
Map its start, finish, standard, decision rights, exceptions, and evidence requirements.
Authorize controlled shadow-to-independent execution with operator involvement limited to defined exceptions.
Inspect commitments, outcomes, rescues, and intervention causes.
Retain, revise, or revert the transfer based on observed fidelity.
Pilot one workflow before extending the ownership model.
Predefine check-ins and escalation before workload pressure rises.
Treat the workflow as a seat-boundary test rather than proof of managerial readiness.

destinations.name: WHY WE BELIEVE IT
destinations.mission: Separate what is known, inferred, missing and contradicted, with explicit mind-change conditions.
